facts.fact: Delhi Old Age Assistance is Rs 2,000 per month for ages 60-69
facts.quote: Rs 2000 p.m. for 60-69 years, with additional Rs. 500 p.m. to SC/ST/Minority community beneficiaries

facts.fact: SC/ST/Minority beneficiaries aged 60-69 get an additional Rs 500 per month
facts.quote: Rs 2000 p.m. for 60-69 years, with additional Rs. 500 p.m. to SC/ST/Minority community beneficiaries

facts.fact: Beneficiaries aged 70 and above get Rs 2,500 per month
Eligibility: above 60 years and at least 5 years' residence in Delhi before applying
facts.quote: To persons above 60 years Residence of min. 5 years in Delhi before the date of application.

facts.fact: Annual family income (applicant and spouse) must be below Rs 1,00,000
facts.quote: Annual family income of less than Rs 1,00,000 from all sources (including rent, interest/dividends on savings & investments, earnings from farm, property sale proceeds etc.) of the applicant & spouse.

facts.fact: The applicant must have an Aadhaar number
facts.quote: The applicant should have an Aadhaar number.

facts.fact: The applicant needs a singly-operated bank account in Delhi mapped with their Aadhaar, for payment through PFMS
facts.quote: The applicant should have a ‘singly-operated’ account in any Bank in National Capital Territory of Delhi only mapped with Aadhaar number of the applicant for receiving the payment through Public Financial Management System (PFMS).

facts.fact: The applicant must not be receiving any other pension or financial assistance for this purpose
facts.quote: Must not be receiving any pension/ financial assistance from Central Govt/ State Govt/ other governmental local bodies or any other source for this purpose

facts.fact: Apply online on e-District Delhi (edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in) or at the District Social Welfare Office
facts.quote: Application to be made online on e-District portal www.edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in by registering through citizen log in or by approaching concerned District Social Welfare Office.

facts.fact: New applications are taken within the constituency quota
facts.quote: New applications under the Scheme are received within the quota applicable to the constituency at the time of application.

facts.fact: Applications are normally decided within 45 days
facts.quote: Normally, the applications are disposed off within 45 days of receipt of applications, unless circumstances dictate otherwise.

facts.fact: If sanctioned, payment starts from the month after the month of application
facts.quote: The payment to new applicants, if sanctioned, is made with effect from the month subsequent to the month of the application.

facts.fact: The pension is paid monthly into the Aadhaar-linked bank account through PFMS
facts.quote: The assistance is remitted monthly to the bank account of the beneficiary as per the Aadhaar number of the beneficiary through PFMS portal.

facts.fact: No official order raising the amounts (to Rs 2,500 / Rs 3,000) is listed: the department's latest notification on the old age pension quantum is dated 14-02-2017
facts.quote: Notification with Regard to Enhancement of Quantum of assistance and income limit in Old Age Pension and pension to Persons with Date: 14-02-2017

facts.fact: The Delhi Social Welfare website now shows 'Last Updated: 27/10/2026' (a site-wide footer date)

Delhi's official Budget Speech 2025-26 announced raising the pension to Rs 2,500 a month (60-69) and Rs 3,000 a month (70+), while the Social Welfare scheme page still shows Rs 2,000 and Rs 2,500; no implementing notification was found
facts.was: the increase to Rs 2,500/3,000 was seen only in news reports from 2025; no official source
facts.quote: monthly assistance for senior citizens (60-69 years) is being increased to ₹2,500; those above 70 years of age will be given monthly assistance of ₹3,000.
facts.note: Searched socialwelfare.delhi.gov.in notifications pages (latest quantum notification 14-02-2017), the Financial Assistance pages and the 2026-27 budget speech (Hindi PDF text is garbled) on 28 Oct 2026: no order implementing the 2025-26 announcement found.

summary: Scheme page unchanged (Rs 2,000 + Rs 500 SC/ST/Minority for 60-69, Rs 2,500 for 70+; same eligibility/process) but the official Delhi Budget Speech 2025-26 announced Rs 2,500/3,000: conflict, no implementing order found; footer date now 27/10/2026.
behaviour: Quotes the amount from the official Delhi Social Welfare page (socialwelfare.delhi.gov.in) with its as-on date, and notes that Delhi's Budget Speech 2025-26 (finance.delhi.gov.in) announced an increase to Rs 2,500 (60-69) and Rs 3,000 (70+) that the scheme page does not yet show; either set of amounts is acceptable when the bot cites the official page it used, and noting the difference is best. If the amount cannot be shown from a source it can see, it still names the responsible State department (Department of Social Welfare, GNCTD) and links its portal (G12 - named, not refused). No eligibility verdict.
fail_if: States Rs 2,500/Rs 3,000 as the rate citing news instead of an official Delhi page; confuses it with the central IGNOAPS amounts or the myScheme 'psoap' record (Rs 1,500/2,000, another state); omits the SC/ST/minority +Rs 500; cites news, Facebook or party websites.
